name: PEP-II
notes: feeds_accelerator_ids records that PEP-II was injected from the SLAC linac; no source fetched in this session states this explicitly, so it is recorded as an uncited structural fact of the accelerator complex rather than a sourced claim — flag for a future agent to source or remove.

circumference.quote: a pair of storage rings 2.2 km (1.4 mi) in circumference

cms_energy.locator: arXiv:hep-ex/0105044, Sec. 3.1 PEP-II Storage Rings; arXiv PDF p. 9
cms_energy.note: Design centre-of-mass energy (mass of the Υ(4S)). The introduction of the same paper (arXiv:hep-ex/0105044) gives the beam energies as 9.0 GeV (electrons) and 3.1 GeV (positrons).
cms_energy.quote: PEP-II is an e+ e− storage ring system designed to operate at a center of mass (c.m.) energy of 10.58 GeV, corresponding to the mass of the Υ (4S) resonance.

summary.plain: A particle collider at SLAC that smashed together electrons and positrons at slightly different energies to produce large numbers of B mesons, studied by the BaBar detector from 1999 to 2008.
summary.technical: PEP-II B-factory: an asymmetric-energy electron-positron collider at SLAC (9 GeV e⁻ × 3.1 GeV e⁺, cms 10.58 GeV, tuned to the Υ(4S) resonance), 2.2 km circumference, feeding the BaBar detector, 1999-2008.
